name: artha
description: Personal Finance Dashboard & Decision Support System

scripts.dev:web: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,electron "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.package:portable: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run package:win -w electron
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend:posix && npm run package:mac -w electron
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend:posix && npm run package:linux -w electron
